title: FINNY Is Now in Claude: Reach Your Growth Partner with Your Prompts
summary: FINNY's connector for Claude for Financial Advisors lets you ask Claude about your FINNY account and get answers from your own data, without switching tabs.
body_markdown:
Today we launched FINNY's connector for Claude for Financial Advisors, Anthropic's suite of AI tools built for advisory work.


The short version: if you use FINNY and you use Claude, you can now ask Claude about your FINNY account and get answers from your own data, without switching tabs.


## Why we built it


Over the past year, we've watched more of our customers move their day-to-day work into Claude. They prep client meetings there, draft follow-ups there and plan their week there.


Checking how prospecting was going still meant leaving that conversation, logging into FINNY and finding the right report.


We'd rather bring the data to where you're already working. If Claude is part of your process, FINNY should be there too.


## What you can do


Once you connect FINNY in Claude, you can:


- **Check campaign performance.** Ask how your latest campaign did and how it compares with earlier ones.
- **Enrich and upload prospects.** Share a file of leads, or pull contacts from another tool you've connected to Claude, such as your CRM. FINNY matches them against its database and adds them to your prospect uploads.
- **Get answers from our help center.** Ask how-to questions and get an answer from FINNY's knowledge base.


## The bigger win: FINNY inside the work you already do


The biggest change is for firms already doing serious work in Claude. Your FINNY data can now sit alongside everything else in the conversation. Pull campaign results into a quarterly marketing review. Clean up a CRM export and send it straight to FINNY for enrichment. Ask Claude to summarize which campaigns are working while you plan next month's outreach.


## You stay in control


You sign in with your FINNY credentials and see only your own account. Nothing is uploaded without your approval. The connector can't build or launch campaigns, and it doesn't export prospect data out of FINNY. You can disconnect it at any time from Claude.


## How to get started


You can reach the connector directly at[claude.ai/directory/connectors/finny](https://claude.ai/directory/connectors/finny) , or you can follow these steps in the app:


1. Open Claude and go to the "Customize" tab to find the connector directory.
2. Find FINNY and select Connect.
3. Sign in with your FINNY email and password.
4. Start accessing FINNY from within Claude.


We built FINNY to make organic growth easier for advisors and to reduce friction everywhere it is slowing you down. Meeting you where you work is part of that.
